title: Announcing Our Zendesk Connector
summary: Whalesync now syncs Zendesk tickets, users, organizations, and custom objects both ways with Jira, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Sheets, and more.
body_markdown:
Zendesk is where a lot of support teams work their queue. The rest of the company usually works somewhere else: engineering in Jira, sales in Salesforce or HubSpot, finance in a spreadsheet. So agents copy ticket details into other tools by hand, and the account details they need sit in apps they can't see.


Our[Zendesk connector](https://www.whalesync.com/connector/zendesk) is live, on the Plus plan. Connect a Zendesk account and you can two-way sync it with Jira, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Sheets, Airtable, a database, or any of the other apps we support.


## **What syncs**


Tickets, users, organizations, and each of your custom objects become tables, with Zendesk’s standard fields and your own custom fields. A ticket’s status, priority, type, tags, requester, assignee, and group all come across, and they sync both ways. Agents, groups, and brands come along as read-only tables, so a ticket’s assignee and group can link to them without syncing every end user.


Zendesk tells Whalesync about most changes to tickets, users, and organizations through webhooks, so they reach your other apps within seconds. Comments and attachments aren’t synced yet.


## **What teams do with it**


The most common setup is escalation. Tag a ticket in Zendesk and it becomes an issue in[Jira](https://www.whalesync.com/connect/zendesk-jira) . The issue’s key and status come back to the ticket, so the agent can see where the fix stands without asking in Slack.


Support and sales can share one view of the customer, too. Sync tickets into[Salesforce](https://www.whalesync.com/connect/zendesk-salesforce) as cases on the right account, or show agents the account owner and renewal stage that[HubSpot](https://www.whalesync.com/connect/zendesk-hubspot) already tracks. Sync Zendesk users and organizations with the people and organizations in[Pipedrive](https://www.whalesync.com/connect/zendesk-pipedrive) , and a phone number changed in one app shows up in the other.


The Jira, Salesforce, and Pipedrive pages each have a short video that walks through the setup.


## **Before you sync**


A change Whalesync makes in Zendesk runs your triggers, just as an agent’s edit would. If you have triggers that email requesters, check them before you sync a batch of tickets in. Deleting a Zendesk user or organization is permanent, so we recommend turning on Delete Protection for those two tables.


## **Getting started**


The Zendesk connector is on the[Plus plan](https://www.whalesync.com/pricing) and up. Enter your Zendesk subdomain, sign in to Zendesk, and pick the tables to sync. Our[Zendesk connector docs](https://docs.whalesync.com/connectors/zendesk) cover every field and how it behaves. If it’s missing something you need,[reach out](https://docs.whalesync.com/resources/support) and tell us.
